module.title: Domain Events, Outbox, Queues and Notification Delivery
module.business_purpose: Provides durable domain events, transactional outbox publication, subscriptions, generic worker queues, retries and dead-letter evidence. User notification delivery is separated into module 35B while remaining in the same messaging schema.

events.note: Realistic connected event backbone: 8 business flows with correlation+causation chains, 14 subscriptions across 7 subscriber services, deliveries with retry and dead-letter scenarios. synthetic_concept_ids should be mapped to terminology (module 03) or a delivery-status value set before production.
